title: North Korea sends letter to UN slamming Seoul over landmine blast
summary: SEOUL — North Korea sent a letter to the United Nations Security Council accusing Seoul of fabricating a landmine explosion that injured three South Korean soldiers, its state media reported…

blocks.text: SEOUL — North Korea sent a letter to the United Nations Security Council accusing Seoul of fabricating a landmine explosion that injured three South Korean soldiers, its state media reported Monday. Tensions between the two Koreas have soared since the South last month blamed the blast inside the heavily fortified Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) that separates the countries on landmines laid by the North, an accusation it has fiercely rejected. The North Korean permanent representative to the United Nations (UN) sent a letter on Sunday to the UN Security Council regarding the “provocation the ROK committed by groundlessly shifting the blame for […]...
